descriptionByLocale.it:
• Operazione, manutenzione e ulteriore sviluppo delle piattaforme di gestione degli endpoint (Intune, MECM/SCCM) con particolare attenzione all'ecosistema Microsoft 365
• Gestione dei moderni luoghi di lavoro Windows 11, inclusi Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise
• Garanzia della sicurezza degli endpoint (Microsoft Defender, SmartCard, Compliance)
• Automazione dei processi operativi e di orchestrazione
• Elaborazione delle interruzioni nel supporto di secondo e terzo livello, nonché collaborazione nei progetti Workplace e M365
• Formazione in informatica (HF/FH) o qualifica comparabile con corrispondente esperienza professionale
• Esperienza nell'ambiente di lavoro Microsoft con particolare attenzione a Intune e Windows Client Management
• Conoscenza di Microsoft 365, Defender, Edge Management e distribuzione software
• Esperienza in automazione, modo strutturato e indipendente di lavorare e forte orientamento al servizio
• Buona conoscenza di due lingue ufficiali e dell'inglese
descriptionByLocale.en:
• Operation, maintenance and further development of the endpoint management platforms (Intune, MECM/SCCM) with a focus on the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
• Management of modern Windows 11 workplaces including Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise
• Ensuring endpoint security (Microsoft Defender, SmartCard, Compliance)
• Automation of operational and orchestration processes
• Processing of disruptions in 2nd/3rd level support as well as collaboration in Workplace and M365 projects
• Computer science training (HF/FH) or comparable qualification with corresponding professional experience
• Experience in the Microsoft Workplace environment with a focus on Intune and Windows Client Management
• Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Defender, Edge Management and software distribution
• Experience in automation, structured, independent way of working and strong service orientation
• Good knowledge of two official languages and English

descriptionByLocale.fr:
• Exploitation, maintenance et développement ultérieur des plateformes de gestion des terminaux (Intune, MECM/SCCM) avec un accent sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365
• Gestion des environnements de travail Windows 11 modernes, y compris Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise
• Garantie de la sécurité des terminaux (Microsoft Defender, SmartCard, conformité)
• Automatisation des processus opérationnels et d'orchestration
• Traitement des perturbations dans le support de 2e/3e niveau ainsi que la collaboration dans les projets Workplace et M365
• Formation en informatique (HF/FH) ou qualification comparable avec une expérience professionnelle correspondante
• Expérience dans l'environnement de travail Microsoft avec un accent sur la gestion client Intune et Windows
• Connaissance de Microsoft 365, Defender, gestion en périphérie et distribution de logiciels
• Expérience en automatisation, manière structurée et indépendante de travailler et forte orientation service
• Bonne connaissance de deux langues officielles et de l'anglais
